payload.title: Target-preserving causal prefix-view learning
payload.statement: Multiple causal prefix views from each outer-training well, all supervised against that well's same original competition-boundary four-control spline target and represented with full E011 feature parity, can regularize coefficient learning without the target mismatch that invalidated T026.
payload.evidence_for: The original-view-only ridge comparator retained a modest aggregate signal at 12.4588330369 RMSE, a 0.0919232588 gain versus E011, and improved all registered horizon and special slices.
payload.evidence_against: Every target-preserving augmented-view candidate was worse than E011. The best eligible view branch lost 0.0411048068 RMSE, won 0/5 maps, regressed every horizon/special slice and four of five spatial and typewell groups. Exact independent reproduction and all controls passed.
payload.next_test: Closed by D033. Do not retune the ten-view catalog, mask blocks, indicators, source weighting, models, or placement grid.
